detours.why: Crampton and MacKimmie have no mapped doors in OSM, so walks start from the nearest mapped path on their east (Sunset Avenue) side, and that path joins the Southwest footways to the Hampshire and Berkshire dining commons only round Crampton's south end or about 90 m north below Prince Hall, so short hops west become loops.

Oak Hall stands on the straight line, Maple's only mapped door is on its west side and Tobin has no mapped door, so the walk leaves Maple, goes round the north of the CHCRC to the path node on Tobin's east side.
OSM joins North Residential Drive to the footway at Montague House's door only at the drive's west end, so the walk runs past Montague to that end and doubles back.
